biospecimens are a critical resource for translational research, and that biospecimen quality, governance, and economics must be carefully considered in developing a national resource.

the creation of a national biobank will require a coordinated effort to develop and implement a comprehensive set of standards for the collection, processing, storage, and distribution of biospecimens.
